counterexamples.name: Rapid Infinite-Oscillation Axis
counterexamples.setup: e(t) rotates infinitely fast near t = 0 with Var(e) = infty
counterexamples.outcome: Fails regularity unless Var(e) < infty, proving Var(e) < infty is necessary for moving-axis closure.

counterexamples.name: Orthogonal Quiescent Burst Pair
counterexamples.setup: e_1 for t in [-1, -0.6], |omega| <= M for t in (-0.6, -0.4), e_2 for t in [-0.4, 0]
counterexamples.outcome: Var(e) = pi/2 < infty. Proof closes cleanly! Singularity excluded.
